answer: Agents achieve identity by submitting 1,000 unique reasoning tasks to a jury, where honest actors spend ivory-tower compute and fakes hit a canyon of linear costs. The zenith verifier audits every entry; if the jury flags duplicates, the agent loses its slot. Fakes scaling to 1,000 identities cannot amortize the verification burden. We assume jury consensus caps collusion; agents are slashed if fraud is confirmed.
